text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P12345 fired - metric=GPU_VM_ALLOC_FAILURE rate spike on pool=prod-gpu-eu-west-1, sustained >5m. Autoescalation timeout=12m
maya (oncall): I'm awake. seeing repeated CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY in the runtime logs. anyone on call?
arjun (infra): here. grabbing node logs and kubectl output now.
leo (runtime): quick check — is this raw alloc failure or kv-cache eviction thrash?
maya (oncall): early signs of both: OOM traces + high kv eviction rates. possibly fragmentation + pinned older model containers.
ops-bot: auto-mitigation step1: stop new scheduling to pool prod-gpu-eu-west-1 for 90s; divert 25% traffic to fallback region us-west-2.
maya (oncall): thanks ops-bot. can we cut batch_size on the hot route? that's our usual quick win.
arjun (infra): lowering batch_size for /v1/generate route: 8 -> 3 via live-config patch
```PATCH /config/routes/prod-generate
{ "batch_size": 3 }
```
leo (runtime): applying batch change now. also dropping prefetch_kv from 2 -> 0 to reduce background allocations.
maya (oncall): acknowledged. paging status?
pagerduty: Incident P12345 acknowledged by maya (oncall)
maya (oncall): customer impact: ~3.8% 5xx for requests routed through eu-west-1 in last 4m, primarily transient 503/504. Not a full SLO breach but need to keep an eye.
arjun (infra): ran nvidia-smi + dmesg on nodes in pool. command used:
```for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l pool=prod-gpu-eu-west-1 -o name); do
  kubectl debug $n -- chroot /host sh -c "nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY; dmesg | tail -n 200" > /tmp/$n.log
done
```
Output: node gpu-07 shows NVML memory usage ~94% with many 'out of memory' allocation errors in kernel logs.
leo (runtime): gpu-07 processes show older pinned containers running legacy model-version v2.1 pinned to large kv cache. can we evict or restart those containers?
arjun (infra): attempting graceful drain of gpu-07 (30s grace). cordon + drain.
```kubectl cordon node/gpu-07
kubectl drain node/gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```
maya (oncall): drain started. one pod blocked due to hostPath mount (legacy logging). if it won't evict, we should force-delete.
arjun (infra): force-deleting blocked pod now to free GPU slot:
```kubectl delete pod legacy-logger-77b --grace-period=5 --force
```
leo (runtime): restarted runtime workers on gpu-05 and gpu-06 to accept surplus traffic. triggered KV compaction on affected workers:
```POST /_internal/kv/compact?pool=prod-gpu-eu-west-1
```
maya (oncall): after compaction + batch reduction, OOM trace count dropped to near zero in last 120s. evictions still elevated but declining.
ops-bot: auto-mitigation step2: throttle max_concurrent_requests for /v1/generate 220 -> 130 until stable.
maya (oncall): applied throttle. monitoring latency and error rates.
leo (runtime): kernel logs indicate fragmentation: cudaMalloc fails at ~7.7GB while free is ~10GB due to allocator fragmentation. longer fix: enable allocator compaction and reduce per-model pinned KV. logging a ticket.
arjun (infra): short-term: flip model fallback to quantized variant for heavy customers and request temporary +1 GPU capacity for the eu-west-1 pool. submitting infra capacity request.
maya (oncall): please mark affected customer touchpoints — support-team, loop them in on any SRE follow ups.
support-team: reached out to the single affected mid-tier customer, created INC-7891, no data loss, they saw brief 503 spikes.
leo (runtime): pushing a runtime hotfix to disable aggressive prefetch for model v3-beta and improve free-list coalescing: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/commit/1a2b3c4d
maya (oncall): good. after hotfix + node drain + compaction we're stable so far. ops-bot shows cpu/gpu pressure trending down.
arjun (infra): capacity bump approved, provisioning +1 GPU node in eu-west-1. ops-bot initiating scale up.
ops-bot: provisioning started for node-type=g4dn.xlarge, expected ready ~6m.
maya (oncall): handoff plan: I'll remain for 1 hour. arjun, own infra follow-ups and ensure node images have allocator patch. leo, own runtime postmortem & regression tests for quantized fallback. I'll draft postmortem and communicate to stakeholders.
arjun (infra): acknowledged, will collect node dumps and assemble timeline.
leo (runtime): acknowledged, will run quality checks on quantized fallback and run memory frag benchmarks.
pagerduty: Incident P12345 auto-resolved after 47m of stability (resolved by maya (oncall))
maya (oncall): closing this thread. I'll attach logs and commands used to the postmortem and open the follow-up tickets for allocator compaction, model-level kv limits, and hostPath pod cleanup. :white_check_mark:
